svg.title: Software build versus reuse
svg.desc: Flow chart down the data path showing, for each stage, which existing crates are reused and which pieces must be written for this project.
svg.text: Telemetry software: what we reused and what we wrote
Stages follow the data path from build tooling to the PC. Orange boxes are the work, with its status.
(done: builds and links, 600 kB with debug info)
Fixed-size buffers inside every crate (done, no heap)
Priority table and task wiring (at bring-up)
embassy-stm32: FDCAN, SDMMC, SPI, I2C, UART, USB,
Pin map checked against the datasheet (done)
Peripheral set-up in the RTIC app (at bring-up)
nothing: no crate covers $PQTMTAR or PAIR commands
tel-core: PPS clock, fusion into samples (done)
The existing asm330lhhx-rs crate does not build
Which pin is red is unverified
can-dbc: reads DBC files in the host generator
MoTeC signals: waiting for your configuration
embedded-sdmmc: SPI-mode SD driver for SD2 only
tel-logfmt: CRC blocks, records, writer, recovery (done)
SD1 and SD2 adapters (done, compile only)
Supervisor in tel-core: cards, fix, LEDs, watchdog (done)
Own CRC-32 and record codec instead of postcard and crc; own signal engine and table generator instead of dbc-codegen;
raw blocks instead of FAT, so embedded-sdmmc is needed only for the SPI driver of SD2; gnss-time and nmea were not used.
Everything marked done passes its tests on the PC. Nothing has run on the board yet.
